name: Project Context page and the agent Context tab on a repository that has no clone
description: Opens Project Context from the sidebar on the seeded demo repo (it has no clone_path) and confirms the page shows its not-cloned state, then opens the seeded Security Reviewer, switches to its Context tab, checks the tab is carried in the URL and that a reload keeps it, with the same not-cloned state in the attach list. Exercises the nav item, /repos/:repoId/context, GET /repos/:id/context, the ?tab=context URL state and GET /agents/:id/context. Read-only: nothing is attached or saved, and no model call is made.

steps.label: open Project Context from the sidebar
the page shows the not-cloned state of the seeded repo
the tab is carried in the URL
the Context tab shows the not-cloned state
the URL keeps the tab after a reload
the Context tab is shown again after a reload
